Meta.defaultDescription: Curio is a curation social network. Save, organise and share the links worth keeping.

Footer.tagline: The internet worth keeping — save, organise and share what matters.

Landing.metaDescription: Curio is a curation social network. Save, organise and share the links worth keeping — and discover inspiring universes built by curious minds.
Landing.subtitle: Save anything, organise it beautifully, and discover the web through the people you trust.
Landing.invalidToken: That invitation link has expired — you can still join as a Discoverer.
Landing.universesSubtitle: Collections built by curious people, on the things worth keeping.
Landing.universesEmptyTitle: The first universes are on their way
Landing.universesEmptyBody: Curio is just opening its doors. Be one of the first to build a public collection worth keeping.

collect.title: Collect anything
collect.body: Links, places, products, ideas — save whatever is worth keeping, from anywhere.

organize.title: Organise beautifully
organize.body: Shape your saves into collections and universes that actually feel like yours.

discover.title: Discover through people
discover.body: Follow curious minds and explore the web through the people you trust.

keep.title: Keep what matters
keep.body: No feed churn. What you save stays — a library that grows more valuable over time.

About.metaDescription: Curio's mission is to map human curiosity — a human-curated internet built on people, not algorithms.
About.intro: Curio is a home for the internet worth keeping — a place to collect links, ideas and places that inspire you, and to discover the universes of other curious minds. People before algorithms, quality over quantity.

human.title: Human first
human.body: People before algorithms. Curation is a human act, and we build for the people doing it.

curiosity.title: Curiosity driven
curiosity.body: Explore, learn, stay open. We reward wandering and depth over the endless scroll.

curated.title: Thoughtfully curated
curated.body: Quality over quantity. The things worth keeping deserve care, not noise.

lasting.title: Built to last
lasting.body: A platform that grows with you — a library that gains value over time, not a feed that forgets.

Editorial.metaDescription: Guides, essays and interviews from the Curio team on curation, taste and the internet worth keeping.
Editorial.subtitle: Guides, essays and conversations on curation and the things worth keeping.
Editorial.emptyTitle: Our first stories are being written
Editorial.emptyBody: The Curio editorial is on its way — guides, essays and interviews on curation and taste. Check back soon.

Curators.metaDescription: Meet the curious minds behind Curio — curators sharing the collections and links worth keeping.
Curators.subtitle: The people building the internet worth keeping, one collection at a time.
Curators.emptyTitle: Our founding curators are on their way
Curators.emptyBody: We're inviting a first circle of founding curators. When they arrive, you'll meet them here — and you could be one of them.

Explore.metaDescription: Discover collections and curators across the topics you care about — travel, design, food, books, culture and more.
Explore.subtitle: Browse by topic and discover collections built by curious minds.
Explore.newEmptyBody: As curators publish their universes, the newest and most noteworthy will surface here.
Explore.collectionsEmptyBody: Public collections will appear here as people start sharing what they keep.
Explore.popularEmptyTitle: The community is just getting started
Explore.popularEmptyBody: Popular curators and collections will rise here once Curio opens to its first members.

Consent.title: Your privacy, your choice
Consent.body: We use cookies strictly necessary for the site to work. With your consent, we also measure usage to improve Curio. Nothing is measured without your explicit consent.
Consent.necessaryDesc: Essential for the site to work (session, security). Always on.
Consent.analyticsDesc: Anonymised usage statistics (PostHog, EU-hosted) to improve the product.
Consent.marketingDesc: Personalisation and targeted communications. No marketing tool is active today.
Consent.policyNote: See our privacy policy to learn more.
